shorts.title: Most Albino Alligators Born in the Wild Die Within a Day
shorts.outro: Doug tries it as a white hatchling in the full video below.
shorts.description: A white alligator hatchling is the brightest thing in the swamp, so most born in the wild survive only about a day, and the full episode shows Doug trying it.

shorts.title: White Lions Aren't Albino, and They Still Hunt Fine
shorts.outro: Doug's seven deaths, and the white lioness, are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Timbavati's white lions are leucistic, not albino, and stand out on dry grass yet hunt about as well as tawny lions; the full episode explains why that matters.

shorts.title: This Town Fines You $750 for Harassing a White Squirrel
shorts.outro: Doug crosses Main Street in a squirrel costume in the full video below.
shorts.description: In Olney, Illinois, albino squirrels have right of way on every street, and the full episode shows what happens when Doug tries crossing as one.
